narrative.title: The Merit Bonus Corridor
narrative.scenario: A firm lines up employees for performance bonuses along a corridor, each with a review score. HR rules: everyone receives at least one bonus unit, and anyone scoring higher than an immediate neighbor must receive strictly more than that neighbor. Finance wants the smallest legal total payout, computed in two smoothing passes along the line.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array ratings of review scores.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the minimum total units required to satisfy both rules.

testCases.explanation: Payouts 2, 1, 2 satisfy both neighbor rules at minimum total.
The tie between the last two needs no differentiation: 1, 2, 1 suffices.

hintLevels: Level 1: One direction at a time — each pass guarantees only its own neighbor rule.
Level 2: Left pass rewards ascending runs; right pass patches descending runs by taking the max.
Level 3: Equal neighbors impose nothing — the max() keeps the earlier grant intact instead of lowering it.
